text_en: I wish you would bear with me in a little foolishness. Do bear with me!
text_cn: 巴不得你们容忍我一点狂妄！其实，你们也应容忍我，

text_en: I feel a divine jealousy for you, for I promised you in marriage to one husband, to present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
text_cn: 因为我是以天主的妒爱，妒爱你们。原来我已把你们许配给一个丈夫，把你们当作贞洁的童女献给了基督。

text_en: But I am afraid that as the serpent deceived Eve by its cunning, your thoughts will be led astray from a sincere and pure devotion to Christ.
text_cn: 但我很怕你们的心意受到败坏，失去那对基督所有的赤诚和贞洁，就像那蛇以狡猾诱惑了厄娃一样。

text_en: For if someone comes and proclaims another Jesus than the one we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit from the one you received, or a different gospel from the one you accepted, you submit to it readily enough.
text_cn: 如果有人来给你们宣讲另一个耶稣，不是我们所宣讲过的；或者你们领受另一神，不是你们所领受过的；或者另一福音，不是你们所接受过的，你们竟然都容忍了，真好啊！

text_en: I think that I am not in the least inferior to these super-apostles.
text_cn: 其实，我以为我一点也不在那些超等的宗徒以下，

text_en: I may be untrained in speech, but not in knowledge; certainly in every way and in all things we have made this evident to you.
text_cn: 纵使我拙于言词，却不拙于知识，这是我们在各方面，在各事上，对你们所表显出来的。

text_en: Did I commit a sin by humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I proclaimed God’s good news to you free of charge?
text_cn: 难道我白白地给你们传报天主的福音，屈卑我自己为使你们高升，就有了不是吗？

text_en: I robbed other churches by accepting support from them in order to serve you.
text_cn: 我剥削了别的教会，取了酬资，为的是给你们服务啊！

text_en: And when I was with you and was in need, I did not burden anyone, for my needs were supplied by the friends who came from Macedonia. So I refrained and will continue to refrain from burdening you in any way.
text_cn: 当我在你们那里时，虽受了匮乏，却没有连累过你们一个人，因为有从马其顿来的弟兄们，补助了我的匮乏；我一向在各方面设法避免连累你们，将来还要如此。

text_en: As the truth of Christ is in me, this boast of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.
text_cn: 基督的真理在我内，我敢说：我这种夸耀在阿哈雅地方是不会停止的。

text_en: And why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!
text_cn: 为什么呢？因为我不爱你们吗？有天主知道！

text_en: And what I do I will also continue to do, in order to deny an opportunity to those who want an opportunity to be recognized as our equals in what they boast about.
text_cn: 我现今作的，将来还要作，为避免给与那些找机会的人一个机会，免得人看出他们在所夸耀的事上也跟我们一样，

text_en: For such boasters are false apostles, deceitful workers, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.
text_cn: 因为这种人是假宗徒，是欺诈的工人，是冒充基督宗徒的。

text_en: And no wonder! Even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.
text_cn: 这并不希奇，因为连撒殚也常冒充光明的天使；

text_en: So it is not strange if his ministers also disguise themselves as ministers of righteousness. Their end will match their deeds.
text_cn: 所以倘若他的仆役也冒充正义的仆役，并不算是大事；他们的结局必与他们的行为相对等。

text_en: I repeat, let no one think that I am a fool; but if you do, then accept me as a fool, so that I too may boast a little.
text_cn: 我再说：谁也不要以为我是狂妄的，若不然，你们就以我为狂妄看待吧！好叫我也稍微夸耀一下。

text_en: What I am saying in regard to this boastful confidence, I am saying not with the Lord’s authority, but as a fool;
text_cn: 我在这夸耀的事上所要说的，不是按照主说的，而是如同在狂妄中说的。

text_en: since many boast according to human standards, I will also boast.
text_cn: 既有许多人按照俗见夸耀，我也要夸耀，

text_en: For you gladly put up with fools, being wise yourselves!
text_cn: 因为像你们那样明智的人，竟也甘心容忍了那些狂妄的人！

text_en: For you put up with it when someone makes slaves of you, or preys upon you, or takes advantage of you, or puts on airs, or gives you a slap in the face.
text_cn: 因为，若有人奴役你们，若有人侵吞你们，若有人榨取你们，若有人对你们傲慢，若有人打你们的脸，你们竟然都容忍了！

text_en: To my shame, I must say, we were too weak for that! But whatever anyone dares to boast of—I am speaking as a fool—I also dare to boast of that.
text_cn: 我惭愧的说：在这方面好像我们太软弱了！

text_en: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.
text_cn: 其实，若有人在什么事上敢夸耀──我狂妄地说：我也敢。他们是希伯来人？我也是。他们是以色列人？我也是。他们是亚巴郎的苗裔？我也是。

text_en: Are they ministers of Christ? I am talking like a madman—I am a better one: with far greater labors, far more imprisonments, with countless floggings, and often near death.
text_cn: 他们是基督的仆役？我疯狂地说：我更是。论劳碌，我更多；论监禁，更频繁；论拷打，过了量；冒死亡，是常事。

text_en: Five times I have received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.
text_cn: 被犹太人鞭打了五次，每次四十下少一下；

text_en: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I received a stoning. Three times I was shipwrecked; for a night and a day I was adrift at sea;
text_cn: 受杖击三次；被石击一次；遭翻船三次；在深海里度过了一日一夜；

text_en: on frequent journeys, in danger from rivers, danger from bandits, danger from my own people, danger from Gentiles, danger in the city, danger in the wilderness, danger at sea, danger from false brothers and sisters;
text_cn: 又多次行路，遭遇江河的危险、盗贼的危险、由同族来的危险、由外邦人来的危险、城中的危险、旷野里的危险、海洋上的危险、假弟兄中的危险；

text_en: in toil and hardship, through many a sleepless night, hungry and thirsty, often without food, cold and naked.
text_cn: 劳碌辛苦，屡不得眠；忍饥受渴，屡不得食；忍受寒冷，赤身裸体；

text_en: And, besides other things, I am under daily pressure because of my anxiety for all the churches.
text_cn: 除了其余的事以外，还有我每日的繁务，对众教会的挂虑。

text_en: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is made to stumble, and I am not indignant?
text_cn: 谁软弱，我不软弱呢？谁跌倒，我不心焦呢？

text_en: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.
text_cn: 若必须夸耀，我就要夸耀我软弱的事。

text_en: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus (blessed be he forever! ) knows that I do not lie.
text_cn: 主耶稣的天主和父，那应受颂扬于永远的，知道我不撒谎。

text_en: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas guarded the city of Damascus in order to seize me,
text_cn: 我在大马士革时，阿勒达王的总督把守了大马士革人的城，要逮捕我，

text_en: but I was let down in a basket through a window in the wall, and escaped from his hands.
text_cn: 而我竟被人用篮子从窗口，沿着城墙系下，逃脱了他的手。
